prompt: give me a top end pc build with unlimited budget, the build should include all the components
response: For an unlimited budget PC build, you'd want the very best components available. Start with an Intel Core i9-13900K or AMD Ryzen 9 7950X for unmatched performance. Pair it with the fastest DDR5 RAM you can find, ideally 64GB or more. For storage, multiple high-capacity NVMe SSDs would be perfect. A top-tier graphics card, like the NVIDIA RTX 4090, is essential.
